extension.author: TraceMyIP
extension.description:
5 Easy Steps to Setup TraceMyIP Tracking

To activate TraceMyIP tracking for Joomla, follow these steps:

  1. Select a Visitor Tracker Icon style and generate a JavaScript version of TraceMyIP.org Visitor Tracker Code. Confirm your TraceMyIP.org account. If you already have a TraceMyIP.org account, login to your account and click on "Add a New Project" menu link to generate a website Visitor Tracker Code for your new Joomla website.
    * If you need to change a tracker style for an existing project, login to your account, go to [My Projects] page and click on the "tracker code" link located to the right of the project's name.
  2. Copy the Visitor Tracker Code and paste it into the [Visitor Tracker Code] input box below.
  3. On the right side panel, select the Tracker Icon Position, Status and Access of the module using the drop down menu [Position] and set to your preference, [Status] to Published and [Access] to public.
  4. Verify that a Visitor Tracker Icon appears on ALL pages of your Joomla website. Go to [Menu Assignment] tab and select [On all pages] module assignment (if not already selected). If you are a Level 2+ TraceMyIP.org subscriber, you can enable an "invisible tracker" option. To locate this option, login to your TraceMyIP.org account and click on [My Projects] menu link and then on the "edit" link for your project.
  5. [Save & Close] the module. Open frontend of your Joomla website to check if the tracker icon appears on all pages of your site.
